why: Turn 1 gave a wrong bare result (20), but after the probe the student traced the fall-through value by value (10, 20, 40, 50) and correctly concluded that value 2 also gives 50, which is a correct trace with no stated purpose.

concepts.quote: 10. Oh wait, then 20, 40, 50… so for 2 it is 50 too.
concepts.why: With no break, the student runs each later case statement in order to the end of the switch.
Each assignment replaces result's old value, so the last one (50) is what remains.
The code and the answer have no ?: operator.
The answer makes no claim about primitive types.
